supercharger_access.notes: Toyota Canada release: "Toyota BEV drivers are now able to enjoy charging through the Tesla Supercharger Network"; 2026 has a native NACS port. Wording is not model-specific.

curb_weight_kg.notes: Relay of Toyota Canada figure for the XLE FWD (57.7 kWh, matches our variant): 1,840 kg (4,057 lb) listed as Weight. Matches US 4,057 lb for XLE FWD.

heat_pump.notes: Quick web lookup. Page lists "Heat pump system for both heating and air-conditioning" for the model without trim qualifier; recorded as standard. Page names no trims; trim coverage unconfirmed.

wheels.notes: XLE: 18-in multi-spoke black/silver alloy with plastic covers. Variant is the XLE FWD (57.7 kWh).
